question: Which of the following rivers is a peninsular river and flows eastward? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 2)
options: Sabarmati
Narmada
Tapti
Mahanadi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Mahanadi.

Explanation:
Mahanadi is a major peninsular river that flows eastward into the Bay of Bengal. It originates from Sihawa in Chhattisgarh. Sabarmati, Narmada, and Tapti are west-flowing rivers. Sabarmati falls into the Arabian Sea, Narmada into the Gulf of Khambhat, and Tapti also into the Arabian Sea. Therefore, among the options, only Mahanadi is an east-flowing peninsular river. The Mahanadi river basin covers parts of Chhattisgarh and Odisha, and its delta in Odisha is highly fertile, supporting extensive agriculture.

☛ Origin of Mahanadi → Sihawa, Chhattisgarh
☛ Mahanadi empties into → Bay of Bengal
☛ Delta of Mahanadi located in → Odisha
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी नदी प्रायद्वीपीय नदी है और पूर्व की ओर बहती है? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 2)
options_hi: साबरमती
नर्मदा
ताप्ती
महानदी
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है महानदी।

Explanation:
महानदी प्रायद्वीपीय भारत की एक प्रमुख नदी है जो पूर्व की ओर बहती है। इसका उद्गम छत्तीसगढ़ के सिहावा क्षेत्र से होता है और यह बंगाल की खाड़ी में गिरती है। साबरमती, नर्मदा और ताप्ती पश्चिम की ओर बहने वाली नदियाँ हैं। साबरमती अरब सागर में, नर्मदा खंभात की खाड़ी में और ताप्ती अरब सागर में गिरती है। इस प्रकार, पूर्व की ओर बहने वाली प्रायद्वीपीय नदी महानदी है, जो ओडिशा से होकर बहती है और इसका डेल्टा क्षेत्र बहुत उपजाऊ है।

question: The location of cement plants is mainly governed by the availability of: (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 2)
options: bauxite
cotton
iron ore
limestone
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is limestone

Explanation:
The location of cement plants is primarily determined by the availability of limestone, as it is the main raw material in cement production. In the manufacturing process, limestone is mixed with clay and other materials, then heated at high temperatures to form clinker, which is ground into cement. Limestone is rich in calcium carbonate, which gives cement its binding properties. Cement plants are established near limestone deposits to reduce transportation costs. In India, the cement industry is concentrated in states like Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu, which have abundant limestone reserves. Bauxite is used for aluminum, cotton for textiles, and iron ore for steel production, making them irrelevant to cement plant location.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Main raw material for cement → Limestone and clay
☛ Basis of cement industry location → Availability of limestone
☛ Largest limestone producing state in India → Madhya Pradesh
☛ Temperature used in cement manufacture → About 1450°C
☛ Major components of cement → Calcium silicate and calcium aluminate
question_hi: सीमेंट संयंत्रों का स्थान मुख्य रूप से किसकी उपलब्धता से निर्धारित होता है: (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 2)
options_hi: बॉक्साइट
कपास
लौह अयस्क
चूना पत्थर
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है चूना पत्थर

Explanation:
सीमेंट उद्योग का स्थान निर्धारण मुख्यतः चूना पत्थर की उपलब्धता पर निर्भर करता है, क्योंकि सीमेंट निर्माण में चूना पत्थर मुख्य कच्चा माल है। सीमेंट बनाने की प्रक्रिया में चूना पत्थर को मिट्टी और अन्य सामग्रियों के साथ मिलाकर उच्च तापमान पर पकाया जाता है। चूना पत्थर में कैल्शियम कार्बोनेट प्रचुर मात्रा में होता है, जो सीमेंट को बंधन क्षमता प्रदान करता है। सीमेंट संयंत्रों को कच्चे माल की आसान उपलब्धता के लिए चूना पत्थर के भंडारों के निकट स्थापित किया जाता है। भारत में सीमेंट उद्योग मुख्यतः मध्य प्रदेश, राजस्थान, आंध्र प्रदेश, कर्नाटक और तमिलनाडु जैसे राज्यों में केंद्रित है, जहां चूना पत्थर के बड़े भंडार पाए जाते हैं। बॉक्साइट एल्युमीनियम उद्योग के लिए, कपास वस्त्र उद्योग के लिए और लौह अयस्क इस्पात उद्योग के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है।

question: What type of rainfall occurs when air is forced to rise over a mountain barrier?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 2)
options: Cyclonic rainfall
Orographic rainfall
Convectional rainfall
Frontal rainfall
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Orographic rainfall

Explanation:
When moist air is forced to rise over a geographical barrier like a mountain, it cools, condenses, and causes precipitation. This type of rainfall is called orographic rainfall. It predominantly occurs on the windward slope of mountains. Cyclonic rainfall is associated with low-pressure systems, convectional rainfall results from intense heating, and frontal rainfall occurs when warm and cold air masses meet. Thus, the rainfall caused by a mountain barrier is orographic rainfall.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ On which side does orographic rainfall occur? → Windward slope
☛ Example of orographic rainfall in India → Western side of Western Ghats
☛ Another name for orographic rainfall → Relief rainfall
☛ What causes orographic rainfall? → Topography
☛ What is the rain shadow region? → Dry area on the leeward side of mountain
question_hi: जब हवा को एक पर्वतीय बाधा के ऊपर उठने के लिए मजबूर किया जाता है तो किस प्रकार की वर्षा होती है? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 2)
options_hi: चक्रवाती वर्षा
पर्वतकृत वर्षा
संवहनी वर्षा
वाताग्री वर्षा
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है पर्वतकृत वर्षा

Explanation:
जब आर्द्र हवा को पर्वत जैसी भौगोलिक बाधा के ऊपर उठने के लिए मजबूर किया जाता है, तो वह ठंडी होकर संघनित होती है और वर्षा करती है। इस प्रकार की वर्षा को पर्वतकृत वर्षा (orographic rainfall) कहते हैं। यह मुख्यतः पर्वतों के वायु-अभिमुख ढाल पर होती है। चक्रवाती वर्षा निम्न दाब क्षेत्रों में होती है, संवहनी वर्षा तीव्र ताप के कारण होती है, और वाताग्री वर्षा गर्म व ठंडी वायुराशियों के मिलने से होती है। इस प्रकार पर्वत बाधा से उत्पन्न वर्षा पर्वतकृत वर्षा है।

question: Which island nation lies to the south of the Lakshadweep Islands?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 2)

question_hi: लक्षद्वीप द्वीप समूह के दक्षिण में कौन सा द्वीप राष्ट्र स्थित है? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 2)

question: Which of the following options best describes the purpose of the Red Data Book? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 2)
options: A list of protected forest areas
A compilation of forest conservation laws
A record of endangered plant and animal species
A collection of tree species
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is A record of endangered plant and animal species

Explanation:
The Red Data Book is a document published by the IUCN (International Union for Conservation of Nature) that records endangered and threatened species of plants and animals. Its purpose is to raise awareness for biodiversity conservation and prioritize conservation efforts. It categorizes species based on their threat status (e.g., extinct, endangered, vulnerable). The Red Data Book is not a list of forest areas, laws, or tree species; it specifically focuses on biodiversity under threat. It serves as a crucial tool for policymakers, researchers, and conservationists to identify species needing urgent protection.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Who publishes the Red Data Book? → IUCN
☛ Which species are included in the Red Data Book? → Endangered and threatened species
☛ What is the main purpose of the Red Data Book? → Awareness and priority for conservation
☛ What is the difference between Red List and Red Data Book? → Red List is IUCN's global list; Red Data Book can be at national level
☛ Which Indian institutions prepare the Red Data Book? → Wildlife Institute of India (WII) and Forest Survey of India (FSI)

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है लुप्तप्राय पौधों और जानवरों की प्रजातियों का एक रिकॉर्ड

Explanation:
रेड डेटा बुक IUCN (International Union for Conservation of Nature) द्वारा प्रकाशित एक दस्तावेज है, जो लुप्तप्राय और संकटग्रस्त पौधों एवं जानवरों की प्रजातियों का रिकॉर्ड रखता है। इसका उद्देश्य जैव विविधता संरक्षण के लिए जागरूकता बढ़ाना और संरक्षण प्रयासों को प्राथमिकता देना है। यह प्रजातियों की संकट की स्थिति (जैसे विलुप्त, लुप्तप्राय, असुरक्षित) को वर्गीकृत करता है। रेड डेटा बुक वन क्षेत्रों, कानूनों या वृक्ष प्रजातियों की सूची नहीं है, बल्कि यह विशेष रूप से जैव विविधता के खतरे में पड़ी प्रजातियों पर केंद्रित है।

question: How does the use of renewable energy contribute to sustainable development?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 3)
options: It rapidly depletes natural ecosystems.
It provides unlimited profits to energy companies.
It increases dependency on fossil fuels.
It reduces environmental pollution and conserves resources
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is It reduces environmental pollution and conserves resources

Explanation:
Renewable energy sources like solar and wind do not emit greenhouse gases during operation, unlike fossil fuels, thus reducing air pollution and carbon footprint. These sources are inexhaustible and replenished naturally, conserving finite resources. Renewable energy minimizes damage to ecosystems and helps mitigate climate change. It enhances energy security by reducing dependence on imported fuels. Sustainable development aims to meet present needs without compromising future generations, and renewable energy achieves this by ensuring environmental sustainability. It also promotes green jobs and energy independence. Overall, renewable energy aligns with the principles of sustainable development by balancing economic growth, environmental protection, and social equity.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the main advantage of solar energy? → It is renewable and non-polluting.
☛ What type of energy is wind energy? → Renewable and clean energy source.
☛ Why are fossil fuels unsustainable? → Limited availability and polluting nature.
☛ What is the primary goal of sustainable development? → Development with environmental conservation.
☛ Give an example of renewable energy. → Hydropower.
question_hi: नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा का उपयोग सतत विकास में कैसे योगदान करता है? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 3)
options_hi: यह प्राकृतिक पारिस्थितिक तंत्र को तेजी से समाप्त करता है।
यह ऊर्जा कंपनियों को असीमित लाभ प्रदान करता है।
यह जीवाश्म ईंधन पर निर्भरता बढ़ाता है।
यह पर्यावरण प्रदूषण को कम करता है और संसाधनों का संरक्षण करता है।
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है यह पर्यावरण प्रदूषण को कम करता है और संसाधनों का संरक्षण करता है।

Explanation:
नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा, जैसे सौर और पवन ऊर्जा, जीवाश्म ईंधन के विपरीत, उपयोग के दौरान ग्रीनहाउस गैसों का उत्सर्जन नहीं करती है, जिससे वायु प्रदूषण और कार्बन फुटप्रिंट कम होता है। ये स्रोत अक्षय हैं और प्राकृतिक रूप से पुनः भर जाते हैं, जिससे सीमित संसाधनों का संरक्षण होता है। नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा पारिस्थितिक तंत्र को नुकसान नहीं पहुंचाती और जलवायु परिवर्तन को कम करने में मदद करती है। यह ऊर्जा सुरक्षा बढ़ाती है और आयातित ईंधन पर निर्भरता कम करती है। सतत विकास का लक्ष्य वर्तमान आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करना है बिना भविष्य की पीढ़ियों की क्षमता से समझौता किए, और नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा इसे पर्यावरणीय स्थिरता सुनिश्चित करके प्राप्त करती है।

question: Which colonial policy is often blamed for the decline of India's traditional handicraft industries?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 3)
options: Zamindari system
Green revolution
Doctrine of lapse
De-industrialisation policy
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is De-industrialisation policy

Explanation:
The decline of India's traditional handicraft industries during British colonial rule is primarily attributed to the de-industrialisation policy. The British turned India into a source of raw materials and a market for British manufactured goods. Indian artisans faced heavy taxes and adverse tariff policies. The colonial government imposed restrictive import duties on Indian handicrafts, while British goods enjoyed free entry into Indian markets. New inventions and the Industrial Revolution led to cheap British products flooding the market, displacing traditional Indian crafts. This resulted in massive unemployment among artisans and severely damaged India's manufacturing sector, forcing many to fall back on agriculture for survival.

question: What is the area around the equator called where the trade winds from both hemispheres converge? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (11/08/2025) Shift 3)
options: Polar Front
Subtropical High
Horse Latitudes
Inter-Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Inter-Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)

Explanation:
The area around the equator where the trade winds from the Northern and Southern Hemispheres converge is called the Inter-Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ). It is a low-pressure belt encircling the Earth near the equator. This zone is characterized by convective rainfall and thunderstorms due to rising warm air. The position of the ITCZ shifts seasonally following the Sun's north-south movement. It plays a crucial role in the global atmospheric circulation system, influencing rainfall patterns in tropical regions. The ITCZ is also known as the Doldrums due to its calm winds.

☛ What is the pressure zone of ITCZ? → Low pressure

☛ What is another name for ITCZ? → Doldrums

question: The Indian handicraft industry suffered significant decline under colonial economic policies. What was a major reason for the decline of Indian handicrafts during British rule? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (12/08/2025) Shift 1)
options: Environmental degradation
Rise of Indian industry
Influx of machine-made British goods
Lack of domestic demand
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Influx of machine-made British goods

Explanation:
During the colonial period, the British government turned India into a source of raw materials and a market for finished goods. After the Industrial Revolution in Britain, machines produced cheap and high-quality cloth, which was imported into India duty-free. This severely impacted Indian handicraft industries, especially cotton textiles and silk industries. Indian artisans could not compete with the price and quantity of machine-made goods. Additionally, British policies imposed heavy duties on Indian products, making them uncompetitive in international markets. As a result, the handicraft industry collapsed, leaving millions of artisans unemployed or forced into agriculture.

☛ Main cause of decline of Indian handicrafts → Duty-free import of machine-made British goods
☛ Effect of Industrial Revolution → Destruction of Indian handicraft industry
☛ British policy → Making India exporter of raw materials and importer of finished goods
☛ Most affected industries → Cotton textiles and silk industries
☛ Result → Migration of artisans to agriculture
question_hi: औपनिवेशिक आर्थिक नीतियों के तहत भारतीय हस्तशिल्प उद्योग में भारी गिरावट आई। ब्रिटिश शासन के दौरान भारतीय हस्तशिल्प के पतन का एक प्रमुख कारण क्या था? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (12/08/2025) Shift 1)

घरेलू मांग में कमी
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है मशीन-निर्मित ब्रिटिश सामानों का आगमन

Explanation:
औपनिवेशिक काल में ब्रिटिश सरकार द्वारा भारत को कच्चे माल का स्रोत और तैयार माल का बाजार बनाया गया। ब्रिटेन में औद्योगिक क्रांति के बाद मशीनों से सस्ते और उच्च गुणवत्ता वाले कपड़े तैयार होने लगे, जिन्हें भारत में शुल्क मुक्त आयात किया गया। इससे भारतीय हस्तशिल्प उद्योग, विशेषकर सूती वस्त्र और रेशम उद्योग, को भारी झटका लगा। भारतीय कारीगर मशीन-निर्मित माल की कीमत और मात्रा का मुकाबला नहीं कर पाए। इसके अलावा, ब्रिटिश नीतियों ने भारतीय उत्पादों पर भारी शुल्क लगाकर उन्हें अंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजार में प्रतिस्पर्धी नहीं रहने दिया। परिणामस्वरूप, हस्तशिल्प उद्योग चरमरा गया और लाखों कारीगर बेरोजगार हो गए या कृषि पर निर्भर हो गए।

question: Which sector(s) employed the largest share of the working population in India on the eve of independence?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (12/08/2025) Shift 1)
options: Secondary sector
Primary sector
Both tertiary and secondary sectors
Tertiary sector
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Primary sector

Explanation:
On the eve of independence, India's economy was predominantly agrarian. Around 72% of the working population was engaged in the primary sector, mainly agriculture and allied activities. Industrialization was very limited, with only 10-12% of workers in the secondary sector. The tertiary sector also employed a relatively small share. Thus, the primary sector was the largest employer, reflecting the underdeveloped economic structure of India.

question: Which of the following is a feature of the Eastern Coastal Plain of India? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (12/08/2025) Shift 1)
options: Wider and formed by alluvial deposits
Presence of numerous estuaries
Located between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea
Narrow and rocky
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Wider and formed by alluvial deposits

Explanation:
The Eastern Coastal Plain of India is wider compared to the Western Coastal Plain and is formed by alluvial deposits brought by major rivers like the Ganga, Godavari, Krishna, and Kaveri. It lies between the Eastern Ghats and the Bay of Bengal, not between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea. It features numerous deltas rather than estuaries (estuaries are characteristic of the western coast). Hence, "Wider and formed by alluvial deposits" is the correct feature of the Eastern Coastal Plain.

question: The Gulf of Mannar lies between: (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (12/08/2025) Shift 1)
options: mainland India and Andaman Islands
India and Sri Lanka
Sri Lanka and Maldives
India and Maldives
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is India and Sri Lanka

Explanation:
The Gulf of Mannar is a shallow bay located between the southeastern coast of India and the western coast of Sri Lanka. It is part of the Indian Ocean and is separated from Sri Lanka in the south by the Palk Strait. The Gulf contains the Gulf of Mannar Marine National Park, known for its biodiversity and pearl cultivation. The region is also famous for the dugong (sea cow). The Gulf of Mannar has been declared a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. It defines the maritime boundary between India and Sri Lanka.

question: The Queen's Stepwell in Gujarat, known officially as Rani-ki-Vav, is situated along the course of which river? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (12/08/2025) Shift 2)
options: Sabarmati
Tapi
Saraswati
Narmada
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Saraswati

Explanation:
Rani-ki-Vav (Queen's Stepwell) is a famous stepwell located in Patan, Gujarat, built in the 11th century by Queen Udayamati of the Solanki dynasty in memory of her husband, King Bhima I. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The stepwell is located along the course of the Saraswati River, which has now dried up but once flowed through the Patan region. Rani-ki-Vav is renowned for its exquisite sculptures and intricate carvings depicting Hindu deities and mythological scenes.

question_hi: गुजरात में रानी का वाव, जिसे आधिकारिक तौर पर रानी-की-वाव के नाम से जाना जाता है, किस नदी के किनारे स्थित है? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (12/08/2025) Shift 2)

question: Which of the following natural regions is known for evergreen dense forests and high biodiversity? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (12/08/2025) Shift 2)

question: Which of the following pairs of neighbouring countries are landlocked and share only land borders with India? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (12/08/2025) Shift 3)

Pakistan and China
Sri Lanka and Maldives

54°7'E and 77°25'E
solution:

Explanation:
The longitudinal extent of India spans from 68°7'E in the west (Kutch, Gujarat) to 97°25'E in the east (Arunachal Pradesh). This covers a distance of about 2933 km and results in a time difference of two hours between the eastern and western parts. The Indian Standard Time (IST) is based on the 82.5°E meridian, which passes through Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh. India lies entirely in the Northern Hemisphere. solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है 68°7'E और 97°25'E

Explanation:
भारत का देशांतरीय विस्तार पश्चिम में 68°7'E (गुजरात के कच्छ क्षेत्र) से पूर्व में 97°25'E (अरुणाचल प्रदेश) तक है। यह लगभग 2933 किमी की दूरी तय करता है। भारत का देशांतरीय विस्तार 30 डिग्री का अंतर दर्शाता है, जिसके कारण पूर्वी और पश्चिमी भागों में दो घंटे का समय अंतर होता है। भारत का मानक समय (IST) 82.5°E देशांतर रेखा (मिर्जापुर, उत्तर प्रदेश) के अनुसार निर्धारित किया गया है। यह विस्तार भारत को उत्तरी गोलार्ध में रखता है और देश के भूगोलिक सीमांकन को परिभाषित करता है।
